plan.title: Implement countByPriority in src/tasks.ts
plan.description: Add exported function countByPriority(tasks: TaskSpec[]): Map<TaskSpec['priority'], number> that counts occurrences of each priority value. Handle empty input by returning empty Map. Ensure correct typing using existing TaskSpec priority type.
acceptance: Function returns Map with correct counts for sample inputs including empty array and mixed priorities
plan.reason: Simple iteration and Map counting, mechanical change to one file
plan.escalate_if: TaskSpec priority type is more complex than string union (e.g., enum or branded type) and requires stronger reasoning

plan.title: Export countByPriority from src/index.ts
plan.description: Update src/index.ts to re-export countByPriority from src/tasks.ts alongside existing parseTasks exports, preserving current exports.
plan.reason: Single-line re-export, trivial dependency on first task
plan.escalate_if: Export structure requires refactoring barrel file
